facts.fact: Adwave's guide recommends an 8-week timeline for planning a grand opening, starting with a foundation phase in weeks 8-6.
facts.quote: We'll walk through an 8-week timeline, free and paid marketing tactics, event planning, and how to sustain momentum after the big day.

facts.fact: Adwave's guide suggests setting geotargeted social media ad targeting to a radius of 3-5 miles from the location, depending on business type.
facts.quote: Set your targeting to 3-5 miles from your location, depending on your business type.

facts.fact: Adwave's guide suggests direct mail to zip codes within a 1-3 mile radius of the new location.
facts.quote: Mail postcards or flyers to zip codes in a 1-3 mile radius.

facts.fact: Adwave states its streaming TV platform is accessible starting at $30 a day.
facts.quote: Platforms like [Adwave](https://adwave.com/how-it-works) make streaming TV accessible starting at $30 a day.

facts.fact: Adwave's guide says a grand opening streaming TV campaign can target households in the service area to build awareness before opening.
facts.quote: Your commercial can target households in your service area, building awareness before you even open.

facts.fact: The page states that AdWave's TV advertising targeting reaches every household within a 10-mile radius of the business's location.
facts.quote: The targeting reaches every household in a 10-mile radius of your location

facts.fact: The page advises starting grand opening advertising awareness two to four weeks before the grand opening date.
facts.quote: Begin building awareness two to four weeks before your grand opening date.

facts.fact: The page advises that the week of the grand opening should feature the heaviest advertising push.
facts.quote: The week of your grand opening should feature your heaviest advertising push to drive maximum attendance.
